g.aria-label: Why Reversing the Source Sentence Boosted 2014 NMT (Sutskever et al.)
Forward Source Order: x_1 → x_2 → x_3 → [ c ] → y_1 → y_2 → y_3
First word x_1 is T steps away from first output y_1 (average lag = T + 1 steps)
Cho et al. (2014): BLEU collapses when source length T exceeds 20–30 words
Reversed Source Order: x_3 → x_2 → x_1 → [ c ] → y_1 → y_2 → y_3
x_1 sits immediately adjacent to c and y_1 (lag = 2 steps instead of T + 1!)
Early target predictions y_1, y_2 anchor on fresh x_1, x_2 before error compounds
4-layer LSTM + beam search reached 34.8 BLEU on WMT'14 English→French
